title: Your first class
description:
Write a class `Counter` that hides one `int` and offers three member functions:

| Member | Does |
|---|---|
| `void increment()` | adds one |
| `void reset()` | goes back to zero |
| `int count() const` | reports the current count |

A new `Counter` starts at 0. The count itself must be `private`, so outside code can only change it through `increment` and `reset`.
hints: Put the three member functions under `public:` and the `int m_count{ 0 };` under `private:`. Initialising the member where it is declared means every new `Counter` starts at 0 without writing a constructor.
`count()` only reads, so it gets `const` after its brackets.
